# AC Infinity Desktop v0.8.1

An update for controller mode selection and popup appearance.

- Choose **Active controller mode** in Schedule to activate its stored program, just like the Status fan's **⋯** menu.
- Load fresh stored settings, including Auto thresholds, into editable fields. **Save settings** edits parameters and retains the active mode; **Save & activate** also activates the selected mode.
- Use **Save & activate** to restart a running timer with its edited duration. Save-only is unavailable while that countdown is active.
- Keep readbacks and documentation captures from activating programs.
- Remove the white native popup gutter and match borders, selected rows, and hover states to the widget.

See the [README](https://github.com/coolshrimp/AC-Infinity-Fan-Controller#readme) for supported controllers, setup, scheduling features, testing limits, and license details.

If this tool helped you out or you enjoy having fan control on your desktop, donations are appreciated. [Support Coolshrimp Modz](https://links.coolshrimpmodz.com/).
